message:
chore(release): 0.2.109 -- Windows only, and no new baseline

Android stays at 0.2.16 / versionCode 15. Neither 422196b nor b4d2a7a touches an
Android file, and a version bump that describes no change makes the number stop
being evidence of anything.

No new baseline either. The premise that 0.2.108 cannot update itself was wrong
and has been withdrawn: start_update_check() reads the cached url and host token
and calls out over https on its own. It does not ask whether the directory is
online or whether a heartbeat succeeded, and the tray entry calls it with no
condition at all. "The connection is blocked" does not imply "the update is
blocked" -- that was an inference, not a finding.

The fixes were confirmed in the artifacts rather than in the build log:

  /healthz            0.2.108 absent -> 0.2.109 present  (GNLinkStream, GNLinkViewer)
  stop budget spent   0.2.108 absent -> 0.2.109 present  (GNLinkHost, GNLinkClient)

Worth recording that HostAgent lives in GNLinkStream.exe, not GNLinkHost.exe --
looking in the supervisor first nearly produced a "the fix is missing" report.

Manifest checked against the staged files, 9/9. A signature says the document has
not changed since it was signed; it says nothing about whether the document
describes files that exist, and on 0.2.108 those two came apart.

Not signed yet: the signing script is behind a permission gate. 0.2.107, 0.2.108
and every APK are untouched, and .claude/rel/0.2.108 was neither read nor written.
